title: An error from the plug-in
about: The stub's page, then at 1 s an error message (the page's error line), and at 6 s a second, longer one.

send.message: The machine did not answer the pattern request.
The kit could not be sent: 3 of 16 SysEx messages were not taken. Check the MIDI cable, that SYSEX RECEIVE is on, and try again.
